definitions.recitedMinutes: Recited time: the union of truth word and labelled-mistake intervals, bridging pauses up to 2 s, minus non-Quran spans. One denominator for misses, false warnings, the checker score and tracker sampling.
definitions.wrongCall: A labelled mistake not confirmed by a matching warning (miss), or a confirmed warning matching no labelled mistake (false warning, including warnings on repeats and restarts). A warning on the mistake's word and occurrence with another error class still catches it, and is counted as misclassified. Free recitation, no context.
definitions.listener: PER of the greedy decode against what was said (truth words with planted wrong and added words applied; non-Quran audio left out), one global alignment per session.
definitions.tracker: Engine run on the listener's evidence. Share of recited time with a locked top candidate within one ayah of a word recited in the last 2 s, counted per entry (session start and every jump of more than one ayah) from 1 word after its disambiguation point. False jump: a run of locks on a wrong place, before or after the point. Lock delay: first on-place sample at or after the point.
definitions.checker: Wrong calls per 5 min of the checker on oracle evidence with oracle tracker events (locked on the true word).
definitions.teacher: Teacher reference: the engine run on the teacher's evidence instead of the listener's, same scoring. A reference for listener quality through the engine, not a bound: the engine is tuned on the listener.
definitions.attribution: Each engine wrong call goes to checker if the oracle arm makes it too, else to listener if the true-position arm (listener evidence, oracle tracker events) makes it, else to tracker. False warnings match across arms by word and time.
